architecture: HDRTVNet++ NPU (structure) -> deterministic nit-targeted luminance remap (PCHIP, soft knee 800-1000, cap ~1200) -> libplacebo presentation -> QSV HEVC Main10 HDR10
curves_domain: gbrp10le full-range RGB, same PCHIP curve on R/G/B (canonical master curve), points = PQ signal V = pq_inv(nits/10000)
libplacebo_stage: tonemapping=none, gamut_mode=perceptual, format=yuv420p10le, bt2020/smpte2084, peak_detect=false, extra_opts=gamut_expansion=on, saturation=1.04
qsv_stage: HEVC Main10 yuv420 bt2020nc/smpte2084, max-cll 1000,400, MD L(10000000,1), ICQ23

fullres_whole_clip.note: final-encode max includes QSV edge ringing; anti-ringing pass selected CQP QP22 + quality best (max 1360, PSNR-Y 57.0 dB, 34.5 Mbps)

notes: percentiles identical across all modes (envelope untouched)
QSV driver clamps CQP QP to min 22
ffmpeg psnr filter down-converts to 8-bit (unusable); PSNR-Y computed manually on raw 10-bit luma, peak 1023

engineering_findings: FFmpeg 9 curves filter normalizes points in signal domain (PQ V), not code/1023; for gbrp10le use x=y=pq_inv(nits/10000)
RGB-domain master curve (same curve on R/G/B) preserves skin hue (+0.37 deg) vs YUV master (+2.74 deg)
FFmpeg 9 drawtext drive-letter escaping needs double backslash (C\:/...)
select='not(mod(n,10))' is a no-op in FFmpeg 9.0.2 (metric scripts sample every frame; consistent across all candidates)
half-res bicubic metrics under-report true max (ONNX 1448 half-res vs 2046 full-res) and can show overshoot

tv_verification.sink: Samsung 65in 2019, supportedHdrTypes=[2,3,4], mMaxLuminance=1000.0, HDR_CONVERSION_PASSTHROUGH, 4K60 active, AMLogic video plane
